words.sense: Previously active or capable of operation but now temporarily inactive.
misconceptions: Anything unseen must once have been active.

words.sense: Already present beneath the surface though not yet expressed or developed.
misconceptions: A paused organization is merely an undeveloped tendency.

semantic_axes.description: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.

edges.boundary_rule: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.

misconceptions.M1: Anything unseen must once have been active.
misconceptions.M2: A paused organization is merely an undeveloped tendency.
misconceptions.M3: Talent that has never been trained is necessarily inactive from a past period.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Leila’s book club?

beats.text: Leila’s club met every Friday last year but has held no meetings since April.
beats.decisive_clue: previously active group has paused meetings
beats.reason: The club once operated but is currently inactive.

beats.text: Members still keep its chat group open and plan to meet after exams.
beats.decisive_clue: formerly active club remains paused with a possible return
beats.reason: Keeping a chat open does not mean regular meetings resumed.

chains.feedback_short: The club used to meet and has paused, though members may restart it.
chains.feedback_deep: Dormant applies to an activity or organization that has stopped operating for a while. Latent instead refers to something present but not yet developed or revealed.
chains.contrast_rule: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

hints.attention: Ask whether the club had an active past.
hints.axis: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.
hints.contrast: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Omar’s weekend delivery business?

beats.text: Omar delivered meals every Saturday for months, then stopped taking orders while his bicycle was being repaired.
beats.reason: A working service has paused for a practical reason.

beats.text: His business page still shows colorful photographs of earlier deliveries.
beats.decisive_clue: previous operations remain paused despite an active-looking page
beats.reason: Old photographs do not mean deliveries are happening.

chains.feedback_short: Old photos do not change the fact that a formerly operating service is paused.
chains.feedback_deep: Dormant describes a temporary end to activity. Latent describes something present but unexpressed; here customers once received deliveries, and that work has stopped.
chains.contrast_rule: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

hints.attention: Which activity is actually happening now?
hints.axis: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.
hints.contrast: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Priya’s resentment toward her friend?

beats.text: Priya always said things were fine, but she kept each unfair remark in a private journal and flinched when the topic came up.
beats.reason: The feeling is already present without being openly voiced.

beats.text: She continued smiling in their group photographs.
beats.decisive_clue: unexpressed resentment persists despite smiling publicly
beats.reason: A smile does not erase feelings kept beneath the surface.

chains.feedback_short: Priya’s private notes reveal resentment she has not voiced.
chains.feedback_deep: Latent feelings exist without clear outward expression. Dormant more strongly suggests something active in the past that has temporarily stopped.
chains.contrast_rule: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

hints.attention: Compare her private reactions with her public behavior.
hints.axis: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.
hints.contrast: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Arun’s garden project?

beats.text: Arun ran the garden every summer for four years, but nobody has planted there since he moved away.
beats.reason: The central activity has been suspended.

beats.text: Its tools and seeds are stored safely, ready for volunteers to resume planting.
beats.decisive_clue: paused work can start again using stored supplies
beats.reason: Readiness to restart confirms a temporary inactive phase.

chains.feedback_short: The garden project previously operated and can resume, though work is paused.
chains.feedback_deep: Dormant fits a project that used to function and could restart. Latent would fit a capacity or feeling present before it takes visible form.
chains.contrast_rule: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

hints.attention: Look for evidence of past activity and current inactivity.
hints.axis: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.
hints.contrast: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Sofia’s interest in teaching?

beats.text: Sofia had never considered applying for teaching jobs aloud, but quietly saved lesson ideas and helped younger cousins learn after school.
beats.decisive_clue: unannounced interest visible through private preparation
beats.reason: Her interest exists before she openly pursues it.

beats.text: She has not yet enrolled in a teaching course or told her friends about those plans.
beats.decisive_clue: interest remains present without being publicly developed
beats.reason: It is not a formerly active career that has paused.

chains.feedback_short: Saved lesson ideas show an interest that has not yet become an open pursuit.
chains.feedback_deep: Latent describes undeveloped or unexpressed interest. Dormant would suggest an established activity that has temporarily stopped, which is not the case here.
chains.contrast_rule: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.

hints.attention: Look for a past career versus an emerging inclination.
hints.axis: Dormant describes activity paused for now; latent describes something already present but not yet openly expressed or developed.
hints.contrast: Dormant has gone quiet; latent has yet to emerge.
